in_arabic.name: أُهى
in_arabic.long_meaning: أُهى هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، والمعنى الحقيقي له هو: «الصلاة»، ويُستخدم اسم أُهى في القرآن الكريم، ويحتوي على أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام، حيث يستخدم في تعبد الله تعالى، ويُعبر عن عبادة الإنسان له، ويُعتبر اسم أُهى من الأسماء التي تُعبر عن العبادة والتوحيد، ويُستخدم في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة، الآية 152، ويظهر معنى الصلاة في اسم أُهى، ويُعبر عن عبادة الإنسان لله

in_urdu.name: أُهی
in_urdu.meaning: فعل اُهی کے معنی صلاة کے ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: اُهی نام اللہ تعالیٰ کے اسماء حسنہ میں سے ایک ہے، اس کا حقیقی معنی ہے: «صلاة»، قرآن شریف میں اُهی نام کی استعمال ہوا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلام میں بہت زیادہ اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جبکہ اس کا استعمال اللہ تعالیٰ کی عبادت کے لیے کیا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام انسان کی اللہ تعالیٰ کی عبادت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور یہ نام انسان کو اللہ تعالیٰ سے وحدت کا احساس دلاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अूही
in_hindi.meaning: अूही नाम का अर्थ है प्रार्थना
in_hindi.long_meaning: अूही नाम अल्लाह के नामों में से एक है, इसका अर्थ है: 'प्रार्थना', अल्लाह के नामों में से अूही का उल्लेख कुरआन में है, और यह नाम इस्लाम में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, जबकि इसका उपयोग अल्लाह की पूजा के लिए किया जाता है, और यह नाम मानव की अल्लाह की पूजा को दर्शाता है, और यह नाम मानव को अल्लाह की वास्तविकता का एहसास दिलाता है, और यह नाम विश्वास को बढ़ाता है

in_pashto.name: أُهى

in_english.name: Uhee
in_english.meaning: Uhee is a name that means prayer and worship

In Islamic tradition, Uhee is considered one of the beautiful names of Allah, and is often used to invoke Allah's blessings and mercy. The name Uhee is also associated with the concept of tawhid, or the oneness of Allah, and is considered a name that reflects the unity and oneness of Allah. In modern times, Uhee has been used as a given name for children, and is often chosen by parents who want to instill in their child a sense of devotion and worship for Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Uhee" can be seen as a reflection of the wonders and beauty of creation from an Islamic perspective. The origins of the name are desert, signifying the arid and seemingly inhospitable environments that often produce the most resilient and precious life forms. In Islamic cultural contexts, deserts represent not only the harshest environmental conditions, but also serve as a reminder of the transcendent power and wisdom of God in bringing life out of seemingly barren landscapes. In this sense, the name Uhee can be seen as a testament to the resilience and adaptability of life, and a reminder of the beauty and wonder that can be found even in the most challenging circumstances.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Uhee can be seen as a reflection of the deep inner essence or soul (ar-rahman ar-rahim in Arabic) that is present in all of God's creation. The root of the name "Uhee" is "hawa" which means "life" or "soul". This connection to the essence of life reminds us of the spiritual significance of every moment and experience, and the importance of cultivating a deep connection to the Creator. The name Uhee can also be seen as a reminder of the importance of recognizing and appreciating the beauty and wonder of creation, and the role of the human soul in reflecting and responding to that beauty. Ultimately, the name Uhee can be seen as a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things in the universe, and the essential role of the human being in recognizing and enhancing that interconnectedness through spiritual practice and loving contemplation.
